title: populus deltoides var. carolinensis
intro: Populus deltoides var. carolinensis, commonly known as Carolina poplar or Carolina cottonwood, is a deciduous tree native to the southeastern United States. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, possibly due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Populus deltoides var. carolinensis are attributed to its emollient, demulcent, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
